text:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — AuroraCloud joint webinar next Thu. Need to lock speaker gifts + accessibility plan. We have 2 VIP keynote speakers and 3 panelists. Shipping cutoff Tue EOD. Ideas for gift types and who handles ASL + captions?
jon-marketing: Love branded but useful things. Thinking travel power bank + nice notebook. keep it under $75.
lee-ux: +1 on useful. Also consider a small plant for their desk? low shipping risk? :seedling:
tasha-events: Accessibility: I can book live captions via StenoLive and request ASL interpreter. Budget ok but need lead time. Do we want to offer speaker honorarium too?
sam-logistics: Shipping heads-up — international addresses will add 3-7 days. Can we get speaker addresses by Mon? Also need customs forms for EU.
maria-partnerships: Addresses: I have US for both keynotes, one panelist in DE. Maria will DM addresses. Any objections to power bank + local artisan notebook combo?
jon-marketing: Sounds good. Can we add a short welcome note with AuroraCloud + Redwood co-signature? keeps it personal.
lee-ux: I can design a 1-sided insert: 2 color, small QR to webinar recording and accessibility notes. Will share comp by tomorrow.
tasha-events: ASL: I'll request interpreter and ping once confirmed. Captions: going to enable live captions + transcript. Also we should add an accessibility line to the invite and speaker briefing.
maria-partnerships: Speaker briefing — can someone add an item about optional mic checks and caption test 15m before?
sam-logistics: OK to ship from our SF office. Draft packing list below: ```
- 2 x power bank (branded)
- 2 x artisan notebook
- 5 x thank you card (co-signed)
- 1 x USB-C adapter (backup)
```
sam-logistics: Shipping timeline I propose: pack Tue morning, drop Wed, international Tue last pickup if urgent.
jon-marketing: Quick thought: custom local snack (DE panelist) might be seized by customs. Maybe skip consumables for intl.
lee-ux: Noted. I'll remove consumable variants from design insert copy.
shipping-bot: Shipment draft created: ID 84F2 — awaiting pickup label generation. Tracking will update here.
maria-partnerships: Who will produce the cards? Jon / Marketing team?
jon-marketing: I can handle note copy + approval. Need final list of names/roles for personalization by Mon 10am.
tasha-events: Also adding accessibility checklist to event run of show: 
```
- Captioning: live on
- ASL: confirmed
- Mic check: speakers 15m prior
- Recording + transcript: auto
```
lee-ux: I put a small CTA on the insert: "Need accommodations? Reply to this thread or email access@redwood" — okay?
jon-marketing: perfect.
maria-partnerships: Great. Action items: Maria DM addresses by EOD, Jon to draft card, Lee to share insert comp, Tasha to book ASL + captions. Sam to confirm pickup. I’ll follow up Wed. :thumbsup:
sam-logistics: Confirmed pickup slot Wed 10am SF. Will post tracking numbers when labels done.
shipping-bot: Label generated for shipment 84F2: https://ship.example/84F2
jon-marketing: I'll post the personalized copy once I get the name list. thanks all.
maria-partnerships: Thanks team — small ask: check dietary restrictions for speaker dinner with AuroraCloud PR. I'll share the invite draft later.
